commitResults.messageTitle: User guide: Explain spaces-only handover notes
commitResults.messageBody:
The preorder section says a handover note of only spaces is rejected
as blank. Plain spaces are trimmed first, so "h/   " clears the notes
like an empty h/. Only Unicode-only values, such as an em space, are
rejected.

Describe both cases so the guide matches the app.

commitResults.messageBody:

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject fulfilment dates before the year 2000
commitResults.messageBody:
A typo such as 0026 is accepted as a valid fulfilment date, so a
preorder can be saved for a date centuries in the past. The only
feedback is the past-date note.

Reject years before 2000 when a user types a fulfilment date in
preorder or find. Saved dates are not checked again, so data files
with older dates still load.

commitResults.messageTitle: Docs: State the year 2000 limit for fulfilment dates
commitResults.messageBody:
The UG and DG describe a fulfilment date as any real calendar date
in YYYY-MM-DD format, and quote the old date error message.

Let's state that typed dates must be from the year 2000 onwards,
quote the new error message word for word, and add a manual-testing
step for a mistyped year. The data file section notes that the limit
does not apply to saved dates.

commitResults.messageTitle: Developer guide: Fix preorder use case extensions
commitResults.messageBody:
Review of the preorder use cases found extensions that do not match
the app. U4 and U7 say an unfound customer gets an error, but find
shows an empty list, and neither covers an invalid customer index.
U5 has no invalid-status case and numbers its no-match case 1a,
though it follows step 2. U7 calls the customer the actor and misses
the nothing-to-clear and past-date cases.

End U4 and U7 when no customer is found and add the invalid-index
case, as U3 does. Add the invalid-status case to U5 and renumber its
no-match case. Reword U7 2c and add the two missing U7 cases.

commitResults.messageTitle: Developer guide: Align U2, U5 and U6 with the app
commitResults.messageBody:
U6 says an unfound customer gets an error and does not include U2,
unlike U4 and U7; the error only appears for an invalid customer or
item number. U5 uses "active status", which the glossary does not
define, and says LeBake shows the relevant items, though it shows all
items and reports a count. U2 has no case for an invalid search.

Make U6 include U2 and end when no customer is found, with an
extension for an invalid customer or item. Name the default statuses
in U5 and describe its result. Add an invalid-search case to U2.

commitResults.messageTitle: Tag command: Log successful tag additions
commitResults.messageBody:
TagCommand does not log anything, while the other customer and
preorder commands log each successful change. This makes tag
changes harder to trace in the log file.

Log an info message when a tag is added, as the other commands do.
